correctness.rationale: The shift of qPhi^2+(1-q-q^2)Phi=1 yields the exact initial triple. Four rational-polynomial identities with fully checked Step-2 truncations prove the complete infinite NextABC transform by induction in even t>=2. The published Hankel fraction determinant formula and telescoping products establish the claimed values at every positive size and zeroes at precisely the complementary sizes. The generating-function denominator is Phi_8(z)^2 with no cancellation, proving minimal quasi-period 8. Standalone symbolic verifier and 23 independent exact determinants reproduce critical calculations, without treating finite enumeration as proof.
